Legacy terradish scale-optimization alias

Source: R/terradish_scale_optim.R
legacy_terra_radish_scale_optim.Rd

Legacy alias retained for backward compatibility with older terra_radish_scale_optim() calls.

Usage

terra_radish_scale_optim(
  formula,
  covariates,
  coords,
  scales = NULL,
  lower = NULL,
  upper = NULL,
  scale_grid = NULL,
  search = c("coordinate", "grid"),
  objective = c("aic", "logLik"),
  grid_points = 5L,
  maxit = 10L,
  tol = 0.1,
  scale_fun = "terradish",
  scale_args = NULL,
  postprocess = scale_covariates,
  directions = 8L,
  theta = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE,
  ...
)

Value

An object of class "terradish_scale_optim", a list with:

par

The selected scale for each raster layer, in the units scale_fun uses (map units for both built-in methods).

value

The outer objective at par. Lower is better, whichever objective was used.

fit

The fitted terradish model at par. Read its conductance coefficients with coef() the same way as any other fit; they are on the log-conductance scale.

surface

The conductance surface built from the rasters smoothed at par, ready to pass to conductance() or plot().

evaluations

A data frame with one row per candidate scale combination: the scale for each layer, the objective value, aic, loglik, and a status column that records "OK" or the error for candidates that failed to fit. Inspect this to see how sharply the objective distinguishes the scales; a flat column means the objective does not identify a smoothing scale within the searched range.

search

The search strategy used, "grid" or "coordinate".

objective

The name of the objective minimized, "aic" or "logLik".

iterations, convergence

Number of outer iterations, and 0 if the coordinate search converged (always 0 for a grid search).
